description: Use this FIRST when asked about a file, directory, or module — returns structure, key symbols, and change hotspots in one call. Best starting point for 'what is this?' or 'what's in this directory?' questions. For questions about a specific symbol, use understand instead.

depth.description: Exploration thoroughness: shallow (quick overview), standard (balanced), deep (comprehensive)

focus.description: Aspect to emphasize: structure (symbols/types), dependencies (imports/exports), changes (hotspots/history)

target.description: File, directory, or module path to explore

name: explore
